title: Bilateral Shoulder Kneading
summary: Both hands perform gentle rhythmic kneading over the upper shoulders at the same time, maintaining symmetry and comfortable pressure.
goal: Work the muscular tissues of the right and left shoulder girdle evenly.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of bilateral kneading over the upper shoulders.
startingPosition: Both shoulders are relaxed. The palms rest on the muscular tissues over the upper shoulders.
instructions: Place both hands symmetrically on the soft shoulder tissues.
Gently grasp and slightly lift the muscle.
Apply a smooth compression with both hands at the same time.
Repeat with the same rhythm on both sides.
direction: Symmetrical kneading over the upper shoulders without moving onto the front of the neck.
tips: Compare the response of the right and left sides.
mistakes: Kneading too deeply near the base of the neck.
warning: Do not continue without professional advice if there is marked one-sided pain, recent injury, numbness, or radiating pain.
telegramCaption: Simultaneous gentle kneading over both upper shoulders.
